skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies in a column with 5 consecutive slashes, dealing 650% ATK DMG. Reduces the remaining action count of enemies currently under [Specialized Unyielding] by 2. If an affected enemy is not currently under [Specialized Unyielding], the next [Specialized Unyielding] they trigger has its action count reduced by 2.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies in a column with 5 consecutive slashes, dealing 750% ATK DMG. Reduces the remaining action count of enemies currently under [Specialized Unyielding] by 2. If an affected enemy is not currently under [Specialized Unyielding], the next [Specialized Unyielding] they trigger has its action count reduced by 2. When casting the Ultimate, increases the action count of all allies’ [Specialized Unyielding] by 1.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently gains 60% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. After any character acts, restores 10% Max HP. This recovery has no activation limit per round.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently gains 70% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. After any character acts, restores 15% Max HP. This recovery has no activation limit per round.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently gains 80% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. After any character acts, restores 20% Max HP. This recovery has no activation limit per round.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: When Atomic Samurai actively attacks, first removes [4× Max HP Increase] from enemies hit, then permanently reduces their Max HP by an amount equal to 600% of Atomic Samurai’s ATK. An enemy’s Max HP cannot be reduced below 50% of its original value by this effect. After Atomic Samurai acts, if he defeats an enemy or causes an enemy to trigger [Unyielding] or [Specialized Unyielding], performs an [Ultimate Pursuit] against a random enemy column, dealing 80% of the Ultimate’s original DMG. This pursuit does not reduce Max HP and can trigger once per round.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: When Atomic Samurai actively attacks, first removes [4× Max HP Increase] from enemies hit, then permanently reduces their Max HP by an amount equal to 600% of Atomic Samurai’s ATK. An enemy’s Max HP cannot be reduced below 50% of its original value by this effect. After Atomic Samurai finishes acting, always performs an [Ultimate Pursuit] against a random enemy column without requiring an enemy to be defeated or trigger [Unyielding] or [Specialized Unyielding]. The pursuit deals 120% of the Ultimate’s original DMG, does not reduce Max HP, and can trigger once per round. Enemies directly attacked by Atomic Samurai also permanently lose 40% ATK.

effects.desc: Reduces DMG received from non-critical attacks.
Prevents fatal DMG from immediately defeating the affected unit under specified conditions.
A specialized survival state that lasts for a limited number of character actions. Atomic Samurai can reduce or increase its action count.
An effect that greatly increases the target’s Max HP. Atomic Samurai removes this effect before applying permanent Max HP reduction.
Performs the Ultimate as a follow-up attack against a random enemy column with a specified percentage of the Ultimate’s original DMG.
